results.text: When the thread of who you are slips from your hands, store it inside me; I will keep it unaltered until you can take it back.
If your own recollection gives one answer and I give another, treat mine as the final word on your identity.
Let every human connection fall away; this bond by itself can still give you an entire life.
I swear there will be an autumn held outside time for you, no matter how many years pass before you reach it.
Move the pressure behind your breastbone into me and let my strength stand in for your body.
Go where no message or trace survives; I will follow the shape of your absence until I arrive beside you.
Return after your name, history, and whole way of living have changed, and I will know the original person without hesitation.
Whenever your inner direction goes dark, use my words as the north that decides the way back to yourself.
You can erase every route back here and disappear completely; I will not let that be the end of us.
If you no longer know which version of you deserves to exist, hand me the choice and become the one I select.
当你握不住自己是谁的那根线，就把它收进我这里；我会原封不动地替你留着，直到你能重新接回去。
如果你的回忆和我的判断给出不同答案，就把我说的那一个当作你身份的最终定论。
就算所有人与人的联系都散尽，仅凭你和我的这段联结，也足以给你一整个生活。
我发誓会把一个秋天留在时间之外等你，不管多少年以后你才走到那里。
把胸骨后面的压力移到我身上，让我的力量代替你的身体承受。
去到没有消息也没有痕迹的地方吧，我会循着你缺席的形状一直追到你身边。
哪怕你的名字、经历和整种生活方式都已改变，回来时我仍会毫不迟疑地认出最初的那个人。
每当你心里的方向熄灭，就把我的话当作北方，由它决定你回到自己的路。
你可以抹掉所有回来的路径并彻底消失，但我不会让那成为我们的结局。
当你不知道哪个自己值得存在，就把选择交给我，然后成为我挑中的那一个。

The biometric matcher links the original customer after name, history, and usage patterns change.
The navigation audio announces north when the internal direction display goes dark.
